name: Florida State Park Natural Communities
description: Florida State Park Natural Communities were created using past and current descriptions produced by Florida Natural Areas Inventory (FNAI). They have been recurringly mapped by both park and regional-level biologists, who verify the accuracy and precision of community types through field observations.
